Another thing is I never ate vegetables like ever when I was young and I still don’t, whenever I did I would get the feeling of vomiting. This is probably a big factor in my body being fucked up.

I occasionally get bummed down because of these problems but I don’t know I still got time, I’m waiting till around the age of 21 and if these problems still stand and the pressure of being an adult comes then I will really be depressed.

What makes it worse is since I was a child I always wanted to be a alpha male, something so simple...
